svg.title: Skills Board
svg.desc: Skills Board. Kid Randy Marsh throws technology blocks into labeled sections of a wooden skills board. The animation plays once and holds the completed skills board. Skills: Python, TensorFlow, OpenCV, React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Firebase, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Flutter, Dart, C++, Git, Linux, Postman. Reduced motion shows every skill in its finished position. No contribution calendar.
svg.metadata: Unofficial South Park fan art. Randy Marsh belongs to the South Park rights holders. Character poses generated from the user-supplied reference. Icons: Simple Icons, CC0. Cloud artwork by OpenMoji, CC BY-SA 4.0. See assets/randy/CREDITS.md.
